explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result or has it as a direct special case. The theorem says that the p-adic inverse of p+1 does not lie in the ℤ-span of any integer cast into ℤ_[p]. This is a very specific fact. The proof combines several Mathlib facts: `Submodule.mem_span_singleton`, `PadicInt.norm_natCast_eq_one_iff`, `PadicInt.mul_inv`, `PadicInt.intCast_eq` and `Int.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mul_eq_one`. None of them carries the full statement. I searched the Mathlib/NumberTheory/Padics files for span-related lemmas. All of them are about `Ideal.span` of powers of p (for example `mem_span_pow_iff_le_valuation`, `maximalIdeal_eq_span_p` and `zmod_congr_of_sub_mem_span`). None is about ℤ-spans or about inverses of integers not being integer multiples.
